About: Every number README.md and the Thermal page quote, in one place. Each value's Readme text appears verbatim in both pages (tests/Ui.Tests/Examples/ThermalExamplesTests.cs), and the Category=Benchmark tests re-run the shipped setups and hold Recorded to Tolerance. Measured once on an Apple M4 (10 cores, 16 GB), macOS 27.0, the Release build, Gmsh 4.15.2, Palace 0.18.1 on 10 processes. A time is the whole run's wall clock through `circuitrf em`; memory is the process's peak resident size, and for the EM run Palace's own peak over its processes.
